deviations_from_card: Two commits instead of four: commit 1 = lib + tests + argv snapshot + test:unit (inert), commit 2 = compose/record-desktop/placeholders switch + README + ADR 0181 + changelog. The snapshot could not come from a real take/placeholder: producing one runs ffmpeg to render video, which the prompt forbids. Instead I wrote the placeholder takes (today's placeholders.mjs take maths copied verbatim, empty media files) to a scratch dir and ran TODAY's compose.mjs --film --dry with ffprobe stubbed through a --import preload. The argv was saved with media paths made relative as scripts/test/fixtures/film-placeholder.argv.json, a plain and a --captions variant (the fixture file is a test asset outside new_files). Added placeholderTakes() to the lib so placeholders.mjs and case 7 build the fixture from the same function; checked equal to the old inline takes. Case 6: refused text keeps compose's existing clock format ('the cut runs 3:20.0, over the 2:59.0 limit'), not the card's literal 'm:ss'. Red-before: all 8 fail on the base tree because the module does not exist. To show which are real defects, I ran the final lib with its two fixes reverted (no next-beat trim, no stale filter): 0, 2 and 4 failed and 1, 3, 5, 6, 7 passed. So case 3 is structural (no shared layClips before), not a behaviour red. Lines: about 974 insertions / 461 deletions, past the ~800 guide, but 161 of those are the JSON argv fixture and 461 deletions are code moved out of compose.mjs. Net code is about +330.
notes: Acceptance cases needing a live capture: none to pass. Case 0's audible effect (a seam clip now fades at the next act's start) and the desktop recorder's stale-clip pacing (case 4 in practice) have only been checked offline; a real `pnpm film:placeholders` + `film:compose --xfade 300` render and a desktop take after a script edit would confirm them by ear and eye. On real cuts, take-mode output only changes when beats overlap, and film mode only when a crossfade seam clip fills its beat; I confirmed both offline. CI does not run test:unit: .github/workflows/ci.yml excludes @athena/journey because its `test` is the e2e. Wiring test:unit in is outside my write set (noted in ADR 0181).
